payload.summary: Medication mappings exist; adopted source batch needs fresh owner signatures
payload.detail: REVALIDATED 2026-10-23 at df1e07db04. 74 medication mappings exist. Preserve the newer adopted-source batch re-signing requirement and separate older-source adoption decisions; remove zero-links/footer claims that were superseded. No clinical approval is supplied. Source inspection only; no fresh application/provider execution or clinical sign-off. Evidence: src/data/medication-source-links.json; docs/decisions/2026-10-22-adopt-medication-page-sources.md. PRIOR DETAIL: UPDATE 2026-10-22 (later): the owner signed 75 sources (#3766), then chose to adopt the 73 sources the medication pages link to (71 TGA PI search records, WA Monitored Medicines Prescribing Code, ScriptCheckWA; docs/decisions/2026-10-22-adopt-medication-page-sources.md). Adoption voids those signatures. Next action: owner re-signs the adopted batch with clinical:review --pack then --write --batch, after which the links render. The older lithium, clozapine, mood-disorder and dictionary sources still need their own adoption decision.
